CustomField.description: Annualized Software Spend excluding Third Party Software
CustomField.formula: IF( TEXT(SBQQ__Product__r.Product_Group__c) = "Software", IF( ISBLANK(SBQQ__ProrateMultiplier__c) || SBQQ__ProrateMultiplier__c = 1, SBQQ__NetTotal__c / SBQQ__SubscriptionTerm__c * 12, SBQQ__NetTotal__c / (SBQQ__SubscriptionTerm__c * SBQQ__ProrateMultiplier__c) * 12 ), 0 )
CustomField.label: Annualized Customer Software Spend
